statement: we leave open whether it is fixed-parameter tractable for the combined parameter τ + d. We introduce a framework for analyzing the parameterized complexity of multistage problems regarding structural graph parameters. We resolve the parameterized complexity of MS2C
context: Discussion and outlook. While we proved that MS2C is NP-hard even if τ = 2 or if d = 1, we leave open whether it is fixed-parameter tractable for the combined parameter τ + d.
